title: Coach Blueprint
description: Blueprint, Step, Exception and decisions for the automation coach (contract v2 entities, camelCase). $defs also hold the rules-engine result shapes and the tool catalog entry. Fields marked x-derived are computed by the engine, are dropped from sync merges and are excluded from the content hash; x-runResult marks the host-written run results of tests (also excluded; x-hashes.contentHash.exclude lists every excluded path). Writers emit only the properties listed here; readers preserve unknown ones (contract v2 section 4).

schemaVersion.description: Schema revision '1.<minor>'. A reader preserves unknown properties of a newer minor; a newer major opens read-only.

version.description: Client edit counter: +1 per accepted local write. It is not the server revision (rev lives only in the sync envelope and sync).

etag.description: Client-local content tag: base64url SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical Blueprint without etag and sync. Not used for sync (If-Match carries rev).

kind.description: new = designing an automation; rescue = diagnosing one that already exists (steps then carry asBuilt).

engine.description: Engine-owned, derived. Meta of the last whole-Blueprint run (computedAt, inputsHash, the host context it used). Sync drops it from merges and recomputes it; excluded from contentHash.

allOf.description: A reopened Blueprint (ruling R3) is a draft until every pending scope is confirmed; the host then removes reopen.

A Blueprint cannot be approved, built or deployed while a step is unconfirmed or has no recommendation, a verdict is missing, a step that needs a justification card (an llm_node or llm_agent recommendation or override, or a recommendation with cardRequired = true) has no confirmed card, or a step whose diagnostic triggers the attractor check (V-ATTR) has no attractorCheck. Before approval none of this is required, so a Blueprint saved mid-interview validates.
A step that needs a justification card (CARD-3, rules-engine.md section 12.2) carries a confirmed one.
A step whose diagnostic triggers V-ATTR carries the attractor check (rules-engine.md section 2.3).

x-virtualFields.description: Data-domain ids that policy governance.dataDomains matches for the step. Computed by the policy layer from the step's name, description, inputs, outputs and systems; never stored in the Blueprint. The org-rule builder offers it next to the real properties.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the Blueprint with every path in exclude removed. It covers content only, so approval survives exports, merges, engine re-runs and test runs. Paths are relative to the Blueprint root; [] means every element of an array; the named property is removed from each object. Generated, not hand-written: the property list comes from the x-derived and x-runResult markers in this schema plus the fixed bookkeeping list. Sync-envelope field; not stored in the Blueprint.

x-hashes.etag: Client-local base64url SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical Blueprint without etag and sync.
x-hashes.engine.inputsHash: SHA-256 (hex) of the canonical engine inputs. Step level (steps[].recommendation.engine): the step diagnostic without provenance, Step.environment, the effective sensitivity class, the EngineEnvironment, the catalog version and the rules-pack constants. Blueprint level (engine): the step hashes, the Blueprint-level facts the engine reads (sensitivity, triage answers, process facts), the pending reopen scopes and the host context {plan, billableSeats}.

blueprintId.description: Prefixed ULID (Crockford base32, upper case): bp_<26 chars>. Generated on the client; ULIDs sort by creation time and do not collide across devices.

stepId.description: Prefixed ULID (Crockford base32, upper case): stp_<26 chars>. Generated on the client; ULIDs sort by creation time and do not collide across devices.

exceptionId.description: Prefixed ULID (Crockford base32, upper case): exc_<26 chars>. Generated on the client; ULIDs sort by creation time and do not collide across devices.

decisionId.description: Prefixed ULID (Crockford base32, upper case): dec_<26 chars>. Generated on the client; ULIDs sort by creation time and do not collide across devices.

testId.description: Prefixed ULID (Crockford base32, upper case): tst_<26 chars>. Generated on the client; ULIDs sort by creation time and do not collide across devices.

exportId.description: Prefixed ULID (Crockford base32, upper case): exp_<26 chars>. Generated on the client; ULIDs sort by creation time and do not collide across devices.

auditId.description: Prefixed ULID (Crockford base32, upper case): aud_<26 chars>. Generated on the client; ULIDs sort by creation time and do not collide across devices.

slug.description: Lower-case slug. One definition shared with policy.schema.json (contract v2 section 4); no dots, because the dot is the toolId separator.

toolId.description: Tool id <namespace>.<name>: exactly one dot, a digit is allowed after the dot, no hyphen. One definition shared with policy.schema.json (contract v2 section 4).

orgToolId.description: Org tool id (policy orgToolEntry.toolId, environment.customTools[]). A subset of toolId.

connectionId.description: Connection id; the built-in managed connection is 'managed'.

modelKey.description: Namespaced model key <namespace>/<id>. managed and byok_openrouter use the OpenRouter id as is; byok_provider <providerId>/<id>; custom_openai_compat custom/<id> (deployment name for Azure); local local/<id>. One convention for Connection.allowedModels[], models.allowlist, prefs.preferredModel.modelId and auditDetails.modelKey (contract v2 section 4). Same pattern and maxLength as policy.schema.json and connection.schema.json.

skillLevel.description: The one skill scale (contract v2 section 4). UI labels are separate copy (basic is shown as Beginner).

rungId.description: Tool ladder. Array order is the ladder order: the engine walks it from the top and the first rung that fits wins. human_checkpoint comes before llm_agent; llm_agent is discouraged and is reached only where a human checkpoint is forbidden or unfit.

operationTag.description: What a step does to its data. Catalog capabilities[] use the same tags. wrapper tags (schedule_trigger, event_trigger) are resolved by a trigger companion, not by coverage.

sensitivity.description: Data sensitivity class. The order is public < internal < confidential < restricted, weakest first (x-order); stricter means later in that order. The Coach model may only raise the class (ruling R4): a call that would keep or lower it is rejected with sensitivity_not_tightening, an accepted raise applies at once and is audited as sensitivity_tightened. Lowering is an owner panel action, audited as sensitivity_changed, subject to data.sensitivityRules. The engine reads the current class at once: a step is evaluated at the stricter of this class and its own dataSensitivity (rules-engine.md section 3.4).

evidence.description: Where the user said it. The host verified quote is a verbatim substring of the cited turn (coach-tools.json).

provenance.description: Who supplied a value. user_stated = the user chose it on a host control or typed or edited it; it needs no evidence, because a click on a host-rendered control cannot be forged by the model (ruling S11). coach_inferred = the Coach extracted it from the user's free text, the user accepted it, and the verbatim quote is required in evidence. engine_derived = computed by the engine, no evidence. The engine reads the value, not the provenance (rules-engine.md section 2.1).

allOf.description: A value the model extracted from free text needs the verbatim quote (contract section 3, ruling S11). A control answer is user_stated and needs none.

ruleAttempt.description: The if/then rule that was tried.

whereItBreaks.description: The user's example where the rule gives the wrong answer.

attractorCheck.description: Evidence gate: required before a step can leave the code family because of uncertainty or language need.

examples.description: Labeled examples the user can supply.

labelSetStable.description: The list of labels is fixed.

outputDeterminism.description: yes = same input always gives the same output by rules; mostly = a rule exists with exceptions; no = experts could differ.

interfaceAvailability.description: For a step touching several systems, the weakest link; per-system detail lives in Step.environment.systems. There is no 'none' value: steps whose systems are all paper_or_phone are exempt (rules-engine.md section 2.1).

operations.description: Engine extension: what the step does, in the order the user described it.

humanAuthority.description: Engine extension: a named person must decide or approve (control, policy or the user's rule).

necessity.description: Engine extension: input to the eliminate rung.

requiredByControl.description: Engine extension: an audit or compliance control needs the step; blocks elimination.

residualHandling.description: Engine extension: what happens to cases the rule cannot decide.

inputVariability.description: Engine extension: how many layouts the input comes in (documents and text).

pathPredictability.description: Engine extension: whether the path can be written down in advance.

inputSize.description: Engine extension: size of one input (a page, a contract, a book).

provenance.description: Field name -> provenance of the value, written by the host. A closed-choice value the user clicked on a host control (show_control) is user_stated with no evidence (ruling S11); a number the Coach extracted from the user's words (volumePerRun, training) is coach_inferred with a verbatim quote.

diagnostic.description: Inputs to the rules engine for one step. All fields optional while the step is being captured; the engine returns needs_info for what it needs, including the attractor check (V-ATTR) when outputDeterminism is mostly or no, languageUnderstanding is some or core, or judgmentRequired is sometimes or yes. The schema does not require attractorCheck here, so a diagnostic saved mid-interview, or one the engine answered needs_info for, validates; the root rule requires it once the Blueprint is approved, built or deployed. Every field except provenance is tool-settable (x-toolSettable): the 12 contract fields, attractorCheck and the nine engine fields. Closed-choice fields are written when the user clicks a host control (show_control); only volumePerRun and training come from a Coach chip (record_diagnostic_answers).

accessModes.description: How the system can be reached. Omitted = derived from interfaceAvailability and kind.

accessEvidence.description: Categorical, never a score: verified = checked by someone with access; claimed = the user said so. The host forces 'claimed' on model writes; only an inspection result may set 'verified'.

uiLocator.description: image_or_coordinates is accepted as an answer so the engine can reject it by name.

stepSystem.description: One system a step touches. Tool-settable: role, accessModes, accessEvidence (host forces claimed on model writes), uiLocator.kind, authModel, profileSystemId. The name comes from a Coach chip (record_environment_facts); the other closed choices are answered on host controls (show_control).

systems.description: Tool-settable: names from record_environment_facts chips, the rest from host controls (show_control).

builderSkill.description: Tool-settable. Unset reads as basic, the same as the default of prefs.skillLevel. The engine never reads preferences; a host that wants the user's own level used writes it into the step.

stepEnvironment.description: Facts from record_environment_facts (system names) and host controls (show_control: system choices, builder skill, tools already owned).

ruleId.description: Predicate or rule id, for example RP-CODE, T-EXEC, ORG-<id>, S-COVER, TB.

questionId.description: Stable id, for example diag.attendance or triage.ownerIdentified.

hybrid.description: How a deterministic spine with edges is reported (rules-engine.md section 14).

envDeltaEntry.description: What blocks a tool here and what would have to change.

engineMeta.description: Versions and a hash of the inputs the result was computed from. A different hash means stale.

plan.description: Entitlement plan, supplied by the host from the signed entitlement token; the engine never reads the token.

billableSeats.description: Billable seats of the organization (Admin, CoE Reviewer or Builder; Viewers are free and not counted). Supplied by the host. Needed for plan team.

engineContext.description: Host-supplied context for the approval gate (rules-engine.md section 12.4, rulings R2 and R7). It is an engine input, so it is part of Blueprint.engine.inputsHash; it is not part of any step's inputsHash and never reaches the Blueprint content.

blueprintEngineMeta.description: Meta of the last whole-Blueprint engine run: the step meta plus the host context the run used. inputsHash covers the step inputs, the Blueprint-level facts the engine reads, the pending reopen scopes and the context.

stepResult.description: Return value of the engine for one step (request_recommendation results[]).

stale.description: Set by the host when any input changed after computation; the engine recomputes it. Never merged between devices.

recommendation.description: Engine-owned, derived. Sync drops it from merges and recomputes it (architecture.md). Excluded from contentHash.

by.description: User id of the person who chose.

status.description: A request that fails OV-1, OV-2, a hard tool predicate or coach.override.mode = forbidden fails without storing, so no failed state exists. A reviewer's rejection of a pending_approval override sets revoked.

override.description: Current effective override on the step. The full record is in decisions[] (kind=override). reason has a 15-character floor; chosenToolId is required unless the chosen rung is eliminate.

allOf.description: chosenToolId is required unless the chosen rung is eliminate.

costPerRun.description: Computed by the engine from a price table supplied by the model catalog or gateway. The engine states no price from memory; basis=unavailable when no table is loaded.

diagnosticFieldName.description: A diagnostic field a justification card may cite.

costPerRun.description: Engine-computed (ruling S2), recomputed whenever the price table or the model changes, dropped from sync merges and excluded from contentHash. The immutable snapshot is decisions[].costPerRun.

provenance.description: Provenance of the card text, keyed by field name like diagnostic.provenance. Only whyNotCode is ruled (R5): the host stores it after the user typed or edited the text, with origin user_stated. Without that provenance the engine counts whyNotCode as not provided (rules-engine.md CARD-6), the same as a missing one.

llmJustification.description: Current card on the step. The full record is in decisions[] (kind=llm_justification). costPerRun is optional because the engine fills it on every write: it is x-derived (excluded from contentHash), so a card validates before the engine has priced it; whyNotCode counts as provided only with provenance.whyNotCode.origin = user_stated.

allOf.description: A confirmed card needs a whyNotCode the user wrote or edited (provenance.whyNotCode.origin = user_stated).

confirmationState.description: proposed = suggested by the Coach or the engine; confirmed = the user confirmed it in the UI (never by a model tool call).

confirmedBy.description: User id of the person who confirmed. Host-written. Absent while the entity is proposed: every return to proposed, including the reset of a reopened Blueprint (ruling R3), clears it.

timePerRunMinutes.description: Optional minutes per run for this step. Not used by the engine in v1: the ROI estimate weighs steps equally.

step.description: One actor, one system, one action. Editing a confirmed step returns it to proposed and marks recommendation.stale. provenance is the Evidence for the step as a whole; per-field provenance lives in diagnostic.provenance.

allOf.description: confirmed needs confirmedBy and confirmedAt; proposed carries neither (a reset to proposed clears both).

confirmationState.description: proposed = suggested by the Coach or the engine; confirmed = the user confirmed it in the UI (never by a model tool call).

confirmedBy.description: User id of the person who confirmed. Host-written. Absent while the entity is proposed: every return to proposed, including the reset of a reopened Blueprint (ruling R3), clears it.

exception.description: Something that goes wrong or differs. handling is the user's words; the Coach never invents it. Step.exceptionRefs is the authoritative link; stepIds is a denormalized back-reference the host keeps in sync.

allOf.description: confirmed needs confirmedBy and confirmedAt; proposed carries neither (a reset to proposed clears both).

provenance.description: Field name -> provenance of the value. Process facts the Coach extracted from the user's words (set_process_info) are coach_inferred with a verbatim quote.

periodsPerYear.description: Runs per year for one period of the frequency, by period.

maintainHoursPerYearByRung.description: Placeholder maintenance hours per year per rung.

triageMode.description: Constants used when no step has been classified yet.

roiConstants.description: The constants an ROI estimate used (rules-engine.md 11.3 and 18.1), copied into the result so the trace shows them. Every value is a number or a map of numbers, by design: the rules pack publishes placeholders, never text. Extra keys are allowed so that a later rules pack can add a constant, but each must be a number or a map of numbers.

gate.description: Whether the payback limit (TR-3) can change the triage verdict. v1 emits advisory until the owner calibrates the constants from design-partner data.

constants.description: The constants this estimate used (periodsPerYear, per-rung build and maintain hours, test overhead, residual share, triage-mode share, payback limits), copied into the result so the trace shows them. All are placeholders (ASSUMPTION).

roiEstimate.description: Hours by default; money only when an org-supplied hourly rate exists. Advisory in v1: it never changes a triage verdict by itself. Derived: excluded from contentHash.

provenance.description: Answer name -> provenance of the answer. The seven answers are given on host controls (show_control), so they are user_stated with no evidence (ruling S11).

triageBlock.description: verdict, rationale, conditions, warnings, ruleTrace and engine are engine-owned (x-derived), recomputed and excluded from contentHash; answers and overrideDecisionId are not.

policyKey.description: Setting that required approval, for example coach.llmOverride.mode.

overriddenRuleIds.description: Soft predicates that the chosen option fails or skips. Hard predicates can never be overridden.

status.description: Same states as Step.override.status. A failed request is never stored; a reviewer's rejection of a pending_approval override sets revoked (and approval.state rejected).

allOf.description: chosenToolId is required unless the chosen rung is eliminate.

provenance.description: Provenance of the card text, keyed by field name like diagnostic.provenance. Only whyNotCode is ruled (R5): the host stores it after the user typed or edited the text, with origin user_stated. Without that provenance the engine counts whyNotCode as not provided (rules-engine.md CARD-6), the same as a missing one.

decisionLlmJustification.description: Append-only record of a justification card. costPerRun here is the snapshot at the time and is part of the content hash; the live value on the step is x-derived.

A proposed card carries no confirmer (a reset to proposed clears confirmedBy and confirmedAt).

A reviewer's rejection of a pending_approval record sets revoked.

decisionOrgRuleWaiver.description: Waiver of a soft org rule (policy orgRule severity warn).

runStats.description: DEFERRED to v1.x (kept so the schema needs no migration then; v1 produces and collects none of it). Aggregate run history for one llm_node step. No raw inputs or outputs are stored in it.

graduationProposal.description: DEFERRED to v1.x; not produced in v1.

decisionGraduation.description: DEFERRED to v1.x; not produced in v1.

then.description: The expected result (older text calls it 'expected').

exampleData.description: Sample input for the test as the user described it.

status.description: Confirmation status of the test case; always equal to confirmationState and part of the content hash. Older drafts also stored the run outcome here; a reader moves passed, failed or skipped to lastRunOutcome and sets status from confirmationState.

lastRunOutcome.description: Outcome of the last run, written by the host from the run report. Run result: excluded from contentHash.

lastRunDetail.description: Detail of the last run. Run result: excluded from contentHash.

confirmedBy.description: User id of the person who confirmed. Host-written. Absent while the entity is proposed: every return to proposed, including the reset of a reopened Blueprint (ruling R3), clears it.

test.description: A test case. status is the confirmation status and agrees with confirmationState. The run result (lastRunOutcome, lastRunAt, lastRunId, lastRunDetail) is separate, host-written and excluded from the content hash, so recording a run never changes an approved Blueprint's hash while confirming a test still does.

backupOwner.description: Role or person who covers if the owner is away.

manualFallback.description: What people do if the automation is down for a day.

reviewAfterDays.description: When to review whether it still pays off. ROI tracking is manual entry at that review.

deployPlan.description: Go-live and monitoring plan written by record_deploy_plan.

allOf.description: confirmed needs confirmedBy and confirmedAt; proposed carries neither (a reset to proposed clears both).

targetId.description: AutoMate flow reference or other target; the same limit as flowRef in the Coach tools (120, contract v2 Lengths).

exportRecord.description: Record that an export was made; the exported file is not stored in the Blueprint. contentHash is the SHA-256 of the exported bytes. Migration of the older 'format' values: spec_markdown -> (process_document, md); spec_json -> (blueprint_json, json); spec_pdf, spec_docx, csv -> (process_document, that format); automate_flow_draft -> (automate_flow_draft, automate_draft).

from.description: Previous value of a changed setting. For sensitivity_tightened and sensitivity_changed it is a sensitivity class.

to.description: New value of a changed setting. For sensitivity_tightened and sensitivity_changed it is a sensitivity class.

turnId.description: Chat turn of the model call that raised the class (sensitivity_tightened).

includesHistory.description: True when the version history was removed with the latest revision (blueprint_backup_deleted; ruling S6 always removes it).

auditDetails.description: Registered detail keys; other keys are allowed and preserved. counts: confirmations_reset. from, to, turnId: sensitivity_tightened (from and to also sensitivity_changed). revisionCount, includesHistory: blueprint_backup_deleted. via: how a Blueprint arrived or how a class was changed (panel, undo).

cards.description: Justification cards (step cards and decisions of kind llm_justification counted once per step) that went from confirmed back to proposed.

confirmationsResetCounts.description: Number of entities that went from confirmed to proposed in a reset (ruling R3); an entity that was already proposed is not counted.

tenantId.description: Opaque, server-issued id of the organisation (tenant). It is the same value as the tenantId of the sync envelope. The client never invents one and never reads meaning into it.

rev.description: Server revision the reviewer approved (the sync envelope rev).

kid.description: Id of the server signing key.

signature.description: Detached signature over the canonical record without signature (ASSUMPTION: base64url, 64 raw bytes for ES256).

approvalRecord.description: Server-signed approval. Carried in auditEntry.details when action = approval_recorded. tenantId names the organisation that issued the record and is inside the signed bytes; an approval gate counts a record only when its tenantId equals the Blueprint's tenant, so a record cannot be replayed into another organisation (rules-engine.md section 12.4, GATE-1). The AutoMate adapter verifies signature and recomputes contentHash from the Blueprint it imports.

attestedBy.description: User id of the owner who attests. Owner role only (the host refuses any other user).

statement.description: The owner's own words, for example that the design was reviewed.

plan.description: Plan the host saw when it recorded the attestation (audit information only; the gate reads the host context at the time it is evaluated, never this field). Enterprise never accepts a self-attestation, so it is not a value.

selfAttestation.description: Review record of the Blueprint owner where no CoE Reviewer is required: Individual (Free or Paid) and a Team with exactly one billable seat (ruling R7). Carried in auditEntry.details when action = self_attested. It is client-made and unsigned and it never sets status approved (it is shown as self-attested). It satisfies an approval-required gate (ruling R2) only while the host context allows it and only for the contentHash it names: a changed Blueprint, a second billable seat or an Enterprise plan makes it stop counting (rules-engine.md section 12.4, GATE-1 to GATE-3).

action.description: Action name; writers use only names registered in x-actions, readers accept any.

auditEntry.description: Append-only. Merged by union on id.

allOf.description: Reset of a reopened Blueprint (ruling R3): counts of the entities that went back to proposed.
Model-raised sensitivity (ruling R4): from and to are classes and to is strictly stricter than from (public < internal < confidential < restricted); turnId names the chat turn.

Owner's one-click Delete backed-up copies (rulings S4 and S6): every server revision of the Blueprint, version history included, was removed and a tombstone (id, time, actor) is left; revisionCount and includesHistory say what was removed.
Sensitivity changed by the owner in the panel or by the undo of a tightening: from and to are different classes.

tenantId.description: The tenant this Blueprint is synced to; null while it is local only. The client uses it to match an ApprovalRecord to the Blueprint's tenant (rules-engine.md section 12.4).

baseRev.description: Server revision the local edits are based on.

syncState.description: rev exists only here and in the sync envelope; version is the client edit counter and is never the same thing.

environmentProfileRef.description: Pointer to a policy environmentProfile and the policy version it was read at.

systemKinds.description: System kinds the tool can work with (hard predicate T-SYS). Empty or absent means the tool does not depend on a system kind and T-SYS passes.

accessModes.description: Access modes the tool uses to reach a system (hard predicate T-ACCESS). Empty or absent means the tool does not depend on an access mode and T-ACCESS passes.

lastVerified.description: Date the entry was last checked against a source.

notes.description: VERIFY: and ASSUMPTION: markers live here.

toolCatalogEntry.description: The 8 contract fields plus the 12 optional extension fields (dataFlow, accessModes, unattendedSupport, hostToolIds, handoff, systemKinds, locatorKinds, connectionTypes, language, maxInputVariability, limits, requiresTrainingData) and catalog metadata. Org tools (policy orgToolEntry, environment.customTools[]) use this shape; when an extension field is absent the engine assumes dataFlow = vendor_cloud and unattendedSupport = no.

toolDataFlowCeiling.description: Highest data-flow class a non-model tool may have for this sensitivity class. Sourced from policy data.sensitivityRules[class].toolDataFlowCeiling; when the policy omits it the projection fills the defaults of rules-engine.md section 3.4.

llmContentMode.description: none = no content may go to any model for this class: the engine treats llm_node and llm_agent as unavailable.

preferredToolIds.description: Org-preferred tools, most preferred first (environment profile preferredToolIds). Used only by tie-breaker TB-0 among tools that already fit at the same rung; never overrides the ladder or a hard predicate.

customTools.description: Org tools from environment.customTools[], projected to catalog entries.

items.description: One resolved action of an org rule whose 'when' matched this step (policy.schema.json ruleAction). The policy layer evaluates 'when'; the engine only consumes forbid_rungs, forbid_tools, require_attended and require_adjacent_rung.

engineEnvironment.description: Read-only projection of policy.environmentProfile + data.sensitivityRules + connections + orgRules. Built by the policy layer; the engine never reads policy directly (rules-engine.md section 3).

via.description: How the Blueprint arrived. A normal sync pull of a newer revision onto the same owner's own device is not an arrival and sets nothing.

items.description: sensitivity = Blueprint.sensitivity; process = frequency, volume, timePerRunMinutes and people; triage = the seven triage answers.

pending.description: Scopes whose values the user has not re-confirmed yet. The engine ignores a pending scope like a missing value (V-REOPEN) and asks again. The host removes a scope when every value in it was confirmed one by one, and removes reopen itself when none is left.

reopen.description: Present only while a reopened Blueprint still has unconfirmed singleton values (ruling R3). The entity-level reset is carried by confirmationState on steps, exceptions, tests and the deploy plan, which the host sets to proposed; this marker covers the values that have no confirmation state of their own. Part of the content hash, so no approval or self-attestation of the received copy carries over.
